WITH gender_order_counts AS (
  SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS invoiced_order_count
  FROM Invoices i
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.gender
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) AS avg_invoiced_order_count
  FROM gender_order_counts
)
SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_order_count) AS average_invoiced_order_count,
       AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - a.avg_invoiced_order_count) AS average_excess_over_overall_average
FROM gender_order_counts g
CROSS JOIN overall_average a
WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > a.avg_invoiced_order_count;
